verdict.rationale: The anthropics/skills repo documents in-agent marketplace commands: `/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills`, then `/plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills` or `example-skills@...`. The Claude Code docs say a marketplace is registered 'with one command' and plugins are installed and loaded as one unit with automatic updates. missing for 10: install is actually a two-step add-then-install flow rather than a single one-liner, no explicit documentation that the installed collection is active in the next session, no independent or hands-on corroboration of the install experience.
